subject: Procurement & approvals mapping — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + procurement mapping (Acme)
Attachments: Acme-procurement-checklist.xlsx

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call + a few questions so we can map the internal approvals and move the commercial path forward:

Summary:
- Decision: Acme is interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput for search and customer support workflows.
- Technical follow-ups: we will send a short SSO and network diagram for your infra team (won't block procurement).

Procurement / commercial questions (can you confirm?):
1) Purchase vehicle: Will procurement be buying via PO/net-30 or will this go on a corporate card?
2) Marketplace: Is purchasing via AWS Marketplace / Azure Marketplace preferred or do you need a direct Redwood contract?
3) Signatory & approvals: Who is the signatory for contracts (name/title/email)? Who is the finance sponsor (owner of budget)?
4) Timeline: Target procurement approval date and any blackout/weeks to avoid for legal/finance reviews.

I've attached a one-page procurement checklist (Acme-procurement-checklist.xlsx) that often helps speed this along — feel free to pass it to procurement.

Next steps I propose:
- Samantha to confirm PO vs card and provide signatory + finance sponsor details (listed above).
- Redwood to gather any required contracting docs (W-9, standard SaaS MA, SOC 2 in our portal) and surface AWS Marketplace options if helpful.

Thanks — want to keep momentum so we can hit your target calendar.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
https://redwood.ai

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement mapping (Acme)

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — great meeting. Quick answers below so we can start routing internally:

1) Purchase vehicle: Procurement prefers a PO on Net-45 for anything over $10k. For pilots under $10k we can approve on a corporate card but enterprise deals will need a PO.
2) Marketplace: We prefer to buy via AWS Marketplace when possible (helps internal tagging and billing), but it's not a hard requirement. If you have a listing or a reseller agreement, send details.
3) Signatory / finance sponsor:
   - Signatory: Kevin Walters, CFO <kevin.walters@acme.com> (final signatory)
   - Finance sponsor / budget owner: Daniel Park, Sr. Director, Platform Engineering <daniel.park@acme.com>
4) Timeline: Procurement kickoff this week; we typically take 3–6 weeks for PO + legal review for a standard SaaS MSA. If we go Marketplace, that can shorten the timeline by ~1–2 weeks.

Documents procurement needs now:
- Completed W-9
- Company address and billing contact
- Redlined contract (if any) or confirmation you use standard Redwood SaaS terms

I'll loop in procurement (procurement@acme.com) on any required paperwork. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps.

—Samantha
Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement mapping (Acme)

Thanks, Samantha — super helpful. A few follow-ups and confirmations: 

> 1) Purchase vehicle: Procurement prefers a PO on Net-45 for anything over $10k.

Understood — we'll plan for PO terms for the production commitment. For the pilot we can accept a card to accelerate initial work, then convert to PO for the long-term subscription.

> 2) Marketplace: We prefer to buy via AWS Marketplace when possible (helps internal tagging and billing)

We do have an AWS Marketplace listing in process; I'll share the listing link if Marketplace is preferred. If you'd like, we can prepare both a direct contract path and an AWS quoting option so your team can compare time-to-production.

> 3) Signatory / finance sponsor: Kevin Walters, CFO; Daniel Park, Sr. Director, Platform Engineering.

Thanks — can you confirm Daniel's preferred PO contact (name/email) and if Kevin expects any special SLA/insurance clauses for sign-off?

Action items from Redwood:
- Attach W-9 and Redwood billing contact (sending now).
- Share AWS Marketplace listing + SaaS MSA template link.
- Prepare a suggested procurement timeline and a short mutual action plan for your legal/finance to review.

I'll send the docs in a follow-up email this afternoon.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Marissa — quick internal note after the procurement thread with Acme:

- They prefer PO/net-45 for >$10k, marketplace speeds things up. Good to offer dual path (Marketplace + direct).
- Finance sponsor = Daniel Park; signatory = Kevin Walters (CFO). We should capture an explicit PO contact (name/email) and confirm if Kevin wants an exec summary SLA.
- Pricing: be prepared to offer a 10% pilot credit if they run a 3-month pilot before commit; sales ops may approve pilot discount under $25k.
- Ask Ben Carter (sales ops) to prepare a clean PO/statement-of-work template and to pre-fill common vendor fields (W-9, address, Redwood billing contact).

I'll join any legal/finance sync if needed this week. Keep the HubSpot deal updated and mark procurement stage: "Procurement engaged".

—Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
